description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'OpenApiConfig' that sets up OpenAPI/Swagger documentation metadata for the DevX Dashboard Backend service. It specifies API info, contact details, server URLs for local and cloud environments, and explicitly mentions that only documentation endpoints are exposed, with all functional business endpoints disabled.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up the OpenAPI documentation for the backend service, including API info, contact, and server endpoints.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenAPI object with metadata, contact info, and server URLs for documentation.
